## Use Comic Code in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Comic Code for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Comic Code', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Comic Code coding font

A programming font based on Comic Sans. Comic Code is a paid monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Comic Code is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Comic Code FAQ

### Is Comic Code free?

No. Comic Code is a commercial font, sold by its vendor.

### Does Comic Code support ligatures?

No. Comic Code has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Comic Code?

Comic Code is available from Official Website. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
